text: This is a follow up to complaint ID XXXX submitted on XX/XX/XXXX. This is about the Synchrony Bank/ Care Credit account ending in XXXX. It either rings and nobody answers, or it's busy all the time. This is obviously a line they provide to people they do not want to talk to.
